answer: The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. A real agent and a mask part ways at Mender wool coat mark sewn into the fitting parlour, and the parting line reads each wool coat is a season of logged stitching plus a signed master-tailor record. Every forge has a toy shop behind it, every ember a ledger, every zephyr a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. An honest proof costs 104 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 726 of them, which totals 75504 POA.
